configurations.name: diabite
runtimeArgs: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && exec npm run dev

configurations.name: diabite-mock
runtimeArgs: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && AGENT_WEBHOOK=http://localhost:8790/diabite exec npm run dev

configurations.name: diabite-nosignin
runtimeArgs: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && VITE_SUPABASE_URL= VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= exec npx vite --port 5174

configurations.name: diabite-google-local
runtimeArgs: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && (GOOGLE_SIGN_IN=on REQUIRE_SIGN_IN=on PORT=8787 npx tsx server/engine.ts &) && AGENT_WEBHOOK=http://localhost:8787/agent/ask exec npx vite --port 5175

configurations.name: diabite-google-5173
runtimeArgs: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && (GOOGLE_SIGN_IN=on REQUIRE_SIGN_IN=on PORT=8787 npx tsx server/engine.ts &) && AGENT_WEBHOOK=http://localhost:8787/agent/ask exec npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort
